title: Reimbursement Ledger Rule — Recoupment of a Paid PAP Therapy Equipment Rental Month
content:
# Recoupment of a Paid PAP Therapy Equipment Rental Month

**Ledger rule.** A payer recoupment or retraction of a paid PAP Therapy Equipment rental month is recorded against that one month, carrying the reference number of the paid month's line as the original bill; a case letter covering several months is recorded as one reversal per month named. A paid month is reversed at most once.

**Effect on the count.** A reversal takes the month out of the paid count, so the next month billed reuses its ordinal only if it was the last paid month; a reversed month inside the period is re-billed only after an appeal is won.

**Effect on the patient.** Every patient charge stemming from the reversed month is removed under the rules of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility, and a patient payment already made on it becomes a credit.

**Evidence.** Whether a paid month has already been reversed is read from the device's billing history — an existing reversal carrying that month's line as its original bill — before a reversal is recorded.

## Where the reversed month sits

| Reversed month | Next month billed |
|---|---|
| the last paid month | reuses the reversed month's ordinal |
| a month inside the period | takes the next ordinal after the last paid month; the reversed month is re-billed only after an appeal is won |

**Examples (hypothetical case letters).** Months 1 to 7 of a period are paid.

- A letter retracts months 6 and 7: two reversals are recorded, one against each month.
- A letter retracts month 7 only: month 7 was the last paid month, so the next month billed reuses ordinal 7.
- A letter retracts month 6 only: month 6 is inside the period, so the next month billed is month 8, and month 6 is re-billed only after an appeal is won.
